title: Complement of an Alternating Quantifier
statement: Let $V$ be a language of bit strings, let $m,k$ be nonnegative integers, let $b$ be a Boolean specifying existential quantification when true and universal quantification when false, and let $w$ be a bit string. The negation of the assertion that $w$ satisfies the $k$-level alternating quantifier condition for $V$, with each quantified string of length $m$ and successive quantifiers alternating, is equivalent to the corresponding condition for the complement of $V$, with the initial quantifier switched.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $m$ giving the length of each quantified string
A natural number $k$ giving the number of alternating quantifier levels
